profile.headline: Software engineer creating innovative, engaging, and efficient software solutions
profile.summary:
An experienced, progressively responsible software engineer professional with demonstrated technical and business skills. This allows me to guide and motivate high-performance software development teams.

PROFESSIONAL DEVELOPMENT
Microsoft Learn-Azure Cloud
DevOps Engineer Expert
Spring/Angular/React
Leading with Credibility
Leading Collaborative Teams


TALK TO ME ABOUT
Cloud Computing
Leading with Credibilty and Leading Collaborative Teams
Artifical Intelligence
DevOps
Software Engineering Process

MISSION
Lead multiple high-performing teams that create innovative, engaging, and efficient software solutions to enrich the lives of Texas' citizens.
 
VISION
Direct the use of information technology and formulate the strategy ensuring that all systems support the business objectives and operations to maximize improving the lives of Texas' citizens. 

CORE VALUES
Collaborative 
Creative 
Excellence
Innovative 
Integrity

positions.title: Manager, Business Systems Integration
positions.description:
Perform project estimates, scheduling, task assignments, and resource allocations for the Web, SharePoint, and FileNet teams.

Guide to the team in resolving complex technical issues bringing about higher completion ratios for SLAs.

Meet customers to prioritize application enhancements, resolve issues, and plan for future technology needs.

Provide coaching and mentoring to 4 business analysts, 5 software developers, and 5 web designers.

Direct unit software development, testing, maintenance, and implementation according to agency policies.

Managed vendor, contractor, and development team in the migration of 15 applications from VB6 to C#.

Adopted automated system testing bringing about shorter lead times for custom features and defect fixes.

Administer the FileNet content management system development to support over 1000 users.

Discerned and led content management system upgrades to save 10% on extended support costs.

positions.title: IT Technical Lead
positions.description:
Assisted in project estimates, scheduling, task assignments, and resource allocations.

Provided technical guidance to the manager during the Legislative Appropriation Request process.

Responsible for technical vendor relations which included development tools feasibility studies.

Resolved and led the team in resolving complex technical issues to meet SLA requirements.

Spearheaded the content management system upgrade to save 10% on extended support costs.

Met with business customers to prioritize feature and defect development activities.

Validated disaster recovery procedures by assigning a different developer in yearly exercises.

Directed unit software development, testing, maintenance, and implementation according to agency policies.

Automated software deployments for the department applications eliminating manual developer tasks.

Led peer-reviews of solution designs, code, and software architecture documentation.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Met with business analysts and customers to prioritize feature and defect development activities.

Performed software development, testing, maintenance, and implementation according to agency policies.

Created and maintained software architecture documentation for systems and applications producing higher completion ratios for SLAs.

Team member in the initial Agile project: an accessible Java web image viewer with FileNet backend.

Developed a FileNet API utility to migrate 50 million images from shared storage into FileNet object stores.

Led the content management system's disaster recovery exercise resulting in updated procedures.

Introduced peer-reviews of solution designs, code, and software architecture documentation.

Mentored developers in quality assurance and automated unit testing bring about fewer reported defects.

Migrated source repository to Subversion enabling matrix traceability for all application commits.
